checks.subject: Exact active/inactive tenant predicate and legacy compatibility
Token lifecycle, replay/uncertainty, audit and transactional design
checks.evidence: Server 32-byte CSPRNG/base64url issuance, SHA-256 only, immutable exact membership binding, at most one active generation, expected revision/attempt, current-auth checked SQL and atomic audit are coherent. Duplicate issue retry returns metadata only; lost URL requires explicit fresh rotation, not escrow or silent generation. T7 and AC2 require rollback/CAS/audit/fetch concurrency evidence, not just adapter success.

checks.subject: Signed narrow RPC and least-privilege owner feasibility
checks.evidence: Dedicated domain/key/short TTL/length-prefixed canonical bytes bind token/IP hashes and management actor/tenant/membership/action/revision/attempt/new hash. It prevents raw anon RPC choosing a fresh IP hash and authenticated direct RPC installing a chosen weak hash. Proof cannot select arbitrary subject/projection. NOLOGIN NOINHERIT owner with exact table/column policies, revoked effective PUBLIC/JWT execute and postgres-owned narrowly filtered key helper is feasible in existing provisioning pattern; no service role is needed. Implementation must prove all effective grants/private helper denial; no code exists yet.

checks.subject: Live subject/assignment authority and commit ordering
checks.evidence: Candidate requires compatible current-authority locking, fetch/revoke ordering and removal/cancel/archive omission on next committed fetch; a fetch admitted before revoke can finish. Existing scheduling/time-report migration locks establish relevant transaction context, but historical tests are not 15.5 evidence. New actual race/barrier tests are required.

checks.subject: Independent limiting, uniform responses, trusted IP and monitoring
checks.evidence: Existing unsubscribe limiter is token/IP paired and accepts caller IP hash; it is unsuitable. Candidate requires independent DB-owned 900s 60/token and 120/IP axes, common invalid-token IP budget, no revoked-only token oracle, safe counters that persist on limited outcomes, Retry-After, bounded global IP housekeeping/cardinality and Admin-only sanitized aggregates. Trusted platform IP is conditional on verified deployment context, otherwise shared unknown bucket. No arbitrary forwarded header or HTTP-controlled test seam is authorized.

checks.subject: Complete minimal calendar serialization
checks.evidence: Live JSON/complete paging avoids PostgREST row caps, one event per current planned own booking, stable booking UID, materialized recurrence authority, omitted cancellation, UTC timed values and Stockholm DATE/exclusive all-day end are coherent. Safe work-role/Bokning summary removes arbitrary description. Independent known bytes/parser, CRLF escaping, UTF-8 folding, DST and >row-cap cases are explicitly required; no arbitrary horizon or stored feed. Large data failure may not become false-empty/partial success.

AC7/T8/T9 require real no-cookie and hostile-cookie HTTP, no Set-Cookie/redirect/304, preserved protected refresh and unchanged unsubscribe behavior.

later tenant fields add nullable provisioning_state; CHECK line25 allows NULL and invitation/provisioning handoff states, no disabled/inactive tenant value; legacy null identity compatibility is explicit at line26
the current resolver gates membership.status==='active'; returns membership-derived tenant and roles at lines128/130, no tenant lifecycle gate
has_tenant_role gates exact active membership and scalar/additional allowed roles; no tenant-active predicate

findings.caller_and_invariant: An authorized existing user with active exact membership, including a legacy tenant whose provisioning_state is NULL, opens settings or presents a previously issued feed. The frozen wording leaves the implementer to invent what independently deactivates the tenant. Treating provisioning_state='ready' as active would deny currently valid legacy membership paths; dropping an undefined inactive-tenant test would leave AC4 untestable. Existing downstream helpers enforce membership eligibility only and cannot resolve this distinct new condition.
findings.minimal_correction: Author should explicitly define eligibility from existing tenant existence, the exact membership's active status and current Bookings.View role union, preserving current legacy NULL provisioning_state compatibility; remove the independent inactive-tenant claim/fixture if that is the intended existing-model meaning. Do not add a new tenant lifecycle or repurpose provisioning_state. If a separate tenant-wide suspension predicate is actually intended, identify its approved existing authority/column or surface that material expansion separately before implementation.
findings.required_revalidation: Targeted High source/spec comparison must confirm kernel, AC4, companion, test/fixture requirements and handoff use one executable current-model predicate. Include legacy NULL+active-member positive and disabled membership/role-loss negative expectations. No new owner question is needed for the minimal existing-model correction.
